sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:9

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:9:1
items.html: MAN anywhere are alluded to by the name BON: For the entire matter of MAN [Mayin Nukvin] comes from the force of the breaking of the vessels and the nullification that occurred in all the Partzufim that came out in the world of Nekudim; and all the corrections that come during the six thousand years, until the days of the Messiah, are only to return and rebuild all these Partzufim to their level, as they were before they were nullified. And it is known that the world of Nekudim is called by the name BON; hence, every discernment that we raise to correct it — which is the MAN — is regarded by the name BON. However, the lights that are newly extended from Ein Sof through all the degrees, to correct the above MAN, are regarded by the name MA, as written above in Part 8.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:9:2
items.html: The MAN themselves, and also the discernment of the Kli itself in which the MAN are placed: You already know that no degree can rise above itself, even a little: for the upper that comes to the place of the lower becomes like it, and likewise the lower that rises to the place of the upper must be like it; for the entire matter of a spiritual difference is only a disparity of form, and as long as there is some disparity of form between the lower and the upper, how can the lower rise to the upper? And therefore, since there is no possibility of correction for the lower in its own degree, unless the upper corrects it within its upper degree — as written at the end of Part 8, that there is no possibility of correction for BYA in their place, but only in their rising to Atzilut, and likewise Atzilut above — a special vessel is therefore needed in each and every degree, whose property is to descend to the place of the degree lower than it and raise it up to its place. And this is what the ARI says: there must necessarily be the discernment of the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] alone, and the discernment of the vessel that raises it alone; for if not, how could the MAN of the lower degree rise to the one above it, as above?

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:9:3
items.html: A woman does not conceive from the first intercourse, for in the first intercourse he made in her the discernment of the Kli, and thenceforth there is a place, etc.: And know that this matter of the vessel for raising MAN [Mayin Nukvin] is one matter with the discernment of the firstborn sons that the ARI wrote in the adjacent item — that it is impossible for any MAN to rise except by their hands. And as we explained there, in every MAN two discernments are regarded: the posterior of the upper and the anterior of the lower; and the posterior of the upper are always regarded as the firstborn brothers to the anterior of the lower — see there. And in this same manner the ARI continues that matter with the MAN of the Nukva, so that from her we may learn the others; for here he explains them well in the secret of the posterior and the anterior of the name HaVaYaH of BON, as brought further along.
